text: Hino woodani ɓe lepte ka nguurndam aduna, ɗe no yanira e maɓɓe wareede e daheede e juuɗe gomɗimɓe ɓen. Pellet ko lepte laakara haɓɓitiiɗe ɓe ɗen ɓurɗe sattande ɓe nise diini lepte aduna ɗen, tawde ko ɗe sattuɗe duumotooɗe ɗe taƴondir- taa. Alanaaɓe reenoowo ɓe e lepte Alla ɗen Ñalnde Darngal.
